zhCN.summary: Sayweave 首个公开 Windows 版本。
changes: 实时语音输入、分段整理与原生输入接续。
手动词典、自动入词和按应用个性化。
紧凑词典界面、稳定历史分页和更新入口。

enUS.summary: The first public Windows release of Sayweave.
changes: Real-time dictation with segmented rewriting and native input handoff.
Manual dictionary, automatic terms, and application-aware personalization.
Compact dictionary UI, stable history pages, and an update entry point.
